summary: Multi-window Electron: webContents.send() loops broadcast IPC to all windows. For request-response, capture event.sender at handler entry. For push events, use BrowserWindow.fromWebContents() ownership; fallback broadcast on null.

title: Re-implement MessagePort backpressure with string-based acks after Buffer pool corruption
summary: Node.js Buffer.from() shares an 8KB slab pool — transferring bytes.buffer over MessagePort detaches the entire pool. Use strings (not binary) for PTY host transport; acks via string messages avoid all shared-memory issues. React StrictMode double-mount also breaks capacity-based backpressure.

title: hover:text-text-inverse renders invisible in dark themes — use text-daintree-text instead
summary: Tailwind/theme tokens: `*-inverse` tokens mean "inverted from normal text," so hover states using `text-text-inverse` render invisible (dark-on-dark) in dark themes — use `text-daintree-text` instead. Repointed the stale `text-canopy-text` reference (renamed in the Canopy→Daintree rename) to `text-daintree-text`.

title: Adaptive resource profiles: hysteresis prevents oscillation when scaling system parameters
summary: ResourceProfileService adaptive profiling (main-process coordinator broadcasting Performance/Balanced/Efficiency config via IPC); trap is profile oscillation under fluctuating load without hysteresis thresholds.

title: refactor(window): scope per-window services into WindowContext.services
summary: Multi-window Electron: storing per-window services as module-level singletons silently destroys other windows' services on close. Per-window services (PortalManager, EventBuffer, MessagePorts) must live in WindowContext.services; global services (PtyClient, WorkspaceClient) stay module-level and only dispose when the last window closes.

title: fix(dev-preview): gate --turbopack injection for Next.js dev servers in webview
summary: dev-preview Next.js webview blank/unstyled pages: webpack style-loader CSS injection fails in Electron webview, so --turbopack is injected, but only gated on Next major >= 15 (resolveNextMajorVersion) and a turbopackEnabled toggle.

title: feat(pty-host): enable bidirectional MessagePort for terminal output
summary: pty-host MessagePort high-throughput path: UtilityProcess can't transfer SharedArrayBuffers, so use MessagePort — but never transfer a slab-aliased node-pty Buffer's .buffer (detaches the shared 8KB pool slab, corrupts sibling Buffers, blank terminals); copy unless the buffer is provably owned.

title: feat(diagnostics): rich diagnostics badge with popover
summary: Memory-trend indicators in the diagnostics resource badge can't be driven by a single snapshot or a last-two-sample delta — GC noise in momentary heap fluctuations produces false "growing" arrows; smooth over a rolling window, show actionable context not raw MB, and gate full process/heap IPC polling on the popover being open to avoid wasteful overhead.

title: feat(recipes): file export/import and in-repo recipe storage
summary: secureEnvVars must be stripped before writing recipes to tracked git paths (.canopy/recipes/). In-memory store retains full data; sanitizeRecipeForRepo() strips secrets from disk representation.

title: feat(memory): reduce memory via completed-agent hibernation and lower thresholds
summary: xterm.js instances hold scrollback + addons + canvas (tens of MB each). Completed/exited agent terminals get pushed to BACKGROUND tier via getTerminalRefreshTier() in src/store/panelStore.ts, triggered by agent lifecycle events (agentState) instead of an idle timer. Per-terminal hibernation itself was fully removed in PR #10811 (TerminalHibernationManager/scheduleHibernation gone) — BACKGROUND now only throttles refresh rate and WebGL context budget, it doesn't free the xterm instance. ProcessMemoryMonitor thresholds scale as fractions of total device RAM.

title: feat(project-switcher): context menu pins, status dots, modifier hints, section split
summary: The project-switcher modifier-hint footer tracks meta/alt via window keydown/keyup listeners (useModifierKeys hook); modifier state gets stuck because Cmd+Tab transfers focus away before keyup fires, leaving a modifier shown as permanently held. Reset modifier state on window blur/visibilitychange.

title: fix(dock): route Escape to terminal/editor when it has focus in dock popover
summary: Radix UI DismissableLayer intercepts Escape in event capture phase before xterm.js sees it. Fix: use onEscapeKeyDown prop with focus-based guard to conditionally block popover dismissal when terminal has focus.

title: feat(panels): allow terminals and browsers without a project open
summary: node-pty cwd='' is NOT cwd=~ — empty string inherits process cwd unpredictably. When currentProject is null, fall back to os.homedir(). Keep ContentGrid mounted always; render WelcomeScreen as empty state inside it, not as replacement.

title: fix: preserve webview partition + flush storage before tab destruction
summary: Two independent webview storage bugs in Electron: partition not propagated through will-attach-webview handler, and storage flush race when destroying tabs before pending writes reach disk.

title: feat(sound): migrate sound playback from OS process spawning to Web Audio API
summary: Electron renderer Web Audio sound playback: pre-decode WAVs at startup. Must serve via custom app:// protocol — file:// blocked by CSP. AudioContext auto-suspends when idle.

title: feat(sounds): add sound dampening for rapid consecutive events
summary: SoundService dampening (debounce/decay/chording) layers before a two-transport split; voice-pool eviction and afplay/paplay volume injection are OS-fallback-only after the renderer Web Audio early return.

title: feat(activity): use process CPU metrics to prevent premature idle transitions
summary: Agent idle detection: use process CPU (10% threshold) as tiebreaker vs output silence. macOS %cpu has 30-60s decay lag reading high after stop — WorkingSignalDebouncer absorbs it.

title: feat(confetti): use active theme colors for celebration particles
summary: Theme-aware confetti in CelebrationConfetti.tsx: read color palette from live CSS custom properties at render time, not from a static module-load array, so particles track theme switches. Updated stale token names (--color-* to --theme-*), the real function name getThemeParticleColors, and the "Canopy" to "Daintree" brand reference.

title: feat(terminal): detect and alert on terminal process memory leaks
summary: Terminal RSS leak detection: 10 consecutive polls (~25s) of NEAR-monotonic growth above 500MB — strict monotonic false-positives on spike-then-plateau indexing. Block auto-restart during active user input.

title: fix(worktree): use async rate limit queue for batch worktree creation
summary: IPC batch failed at EXACTLY 10: used checkRateLimit (sync throw) instead of waitForRateLimitSlot (async queue). Shared 'gitOps' category means unrelated git ops consume worktree quota.

title: Defer scrollback restore to after project switch completes
summary: stateHydration scrollback-restore scheduling: deferring all terminal scrollback restore off the project-switch critical path via a single scheduler.postTask background-priority path (no critical/lazy split anymore), with a user-triggered retry-batch for failed restores.

title: Sound file paths broken in dev and packaged builds
summary: Electron ASAR: files spawned by EXTERNAL OS processes (afplay, paplay, PowerShell) cannot read inside app.asar — needs asarUnpack AND extraResources. Use app.isPackaged + process.resourcesPath in prod.

title: Open union type pattern preserves autocomplete while allowing plugin extensions
summary: TypeScript open union for plugin IDs: `BuiltInActionId | (string & {})` keeps autocomplete while accepting arbitrary strings. Plain `string` collapses union and loses suggestions.

title: Radix UI dropdown dismisses before Playwright click lands on Windows
summary: Radix dropdowns dismiss before Playwright click on Windows: synthesized click fires focus change mid-sequence, triggering onOpenChange. Fix: ensureWindowFocused() then hover() before click().

title: electron-updater requires allowDowngrade: true when switching from nightly to stable
summary: electron-updater refuses nightly→stable because version cmp treats it as downgrade regardless of feed URL. Set autoUpdater.allowDowngrade = channel !== 'stable' on init AND setChannel().

title: fix(workspace): fix git polling queue concurrency
summary: PQueue gotcha: pollQueue.clear() removes QUEUED but does NOT cancel in-flight work. Pass AbortController signal to queue.add() and abort in stop(). Add per-monitor dedup guard for rapid intervals.

title: feat(build): add better-sqlite3 ABI validation and smoke check
summary: better-sqlite3 on Electron Windows: prebuild-install SILENTLY wins against electron-rebuild, fetching Node ABI not Electron ABI → ERR_DLOPEN_FAILED. Add afterPack ABI check + Database(':memory:') smoke.

title: fix(terminal): apply resize synchronously for warm terminals during project switch
summary: xterm warm-reattach resize flash: setTargetSize() only resized inside attach() via rAF (needed cold for WebGL DOM init). Warm path must call terminal.resize() synchronously before first paint.

title: fix(browser): support IPv6 localhost and unsafe-eval in webview CSP
summary: Webview CSP for local dev: isLocalhostUrl must match [::1] (IPv6 loopback default on modern stacks). script-src needs 'unsafe-eval' — Vite HMR uses eval() for module updates.

title: fix(cli): add multi-strategy Linux binary discovery and PATH symlink
summary: Linux binary discovery: AppImage runs from /tmp/.mount_*/ — use $APPIMAGE env var, not command -v. .deb to /opt/Canopy/ with NO PATH symlink — add postinst creating /usr/bin/canopy-app symlink.

title: fix(pty): replace wmic with PowerShell Get-CimInstance for process start time on Windows
summary: wmic REMOVED from Windows 11 (deprecated 10 21H1). Use PowerShell Get-CimInstance Win32_Process — output ISO DateTime (wmic was YYYYMMDDHHMMSS.mmmmm±ZZZ), update parse regex. Silent catch→null hid it.

title: fix(menu): show productName instead of the npm package name in the macOS About menu
summary: Electron package.json: omitting productName leaks the npm-safe name into the macOS About menu, and adding productName silently shifts the userData path — mitigated by hardcoding the dev userData dir.

title: git fsmonitor in hardened config contaminates concurrent worktree status (reverted)
summary: PR #4460 enabled core.fsmonitor/untrackedCache in the hardened git factory for faster status polling, but the shared fsmonitor daemon raced across concurrent per-worktree `git status` calls and returned cross-contaminated changed-file sets; commit 0869bef39 reverted both flags to false and throttled refreshAll() through the poll queue instead.

title: feat(theme): auto-switch theme when system appearance changes
summary: nativeTheme 'updated' fires before macOS appearance is stable — always debounce 300ms before reading shouldUseDarkColors

title: feat(store): atomic state swap for project switching
summary: Zustand project switch: two-phase reset+rehydrate causes visible empty-render flash (terminal registry = [] between phases). Do an atomic swap in one update; only run teardown on stores with listeners (PTY).

title: fix(cli): generate stable wrapper for AppImage CLI symlink
summary: AppImage FUSE mount path in process.resourcesPath is ephemeral — generate a wrapper script that uses $APPIMAGE env var at runtime instead of symlinking into the mount path

title: fix(git): deduplicate in-flight git status operations per worktree
summary: Polling + fs-watcher fire git status concurrently per worktree. Coalesce with in-flight Promise<Result> map keyed by path, clean up via .finally() (never leave failed promises stuck), expose forceRefresh bypass.

title: content-visibility:auto breaks dnd-kit transforms — use Virtuoso windowing on sortable rows
summary: Worktree sidebar DnD: putting content-visibility:auto on dnd-kit-transformed sortable rows breaks reorder displacement; use react-virtuoso windowing instead and reserve content-visibility for non-draggable wrappers. Repointed the regression-guard test path to src/components/DragDrop/__tests__/SortableWorktreeCard.test.tsx.

title: fix(browser): prevent dark-mode color-scheme inheritance into webview
summary: color-scheme is inherited into webview elements — Chromium built-in viewers (JSON viewer) read it and apply hardcoded colors for the wrong mode; reset with webview { color-scheme: normal }

title: fix(ui): constrain dropdown and context menu height to available viewport space
summary: Radix UI DropdownMenuContent/ContextMenuContent don't auto-constrain height. Add max-h-[var(--radix-*-content-available-height)] overflow-y-auto or menus overflow viewport on Linux CI (1200x763), breaking E2E clicks.

title: fix(pty-host): add PtyPauseCoordinator for coordinated PTY flow control
summary: node-pty pause/resume is not reference-counted. Multiple callers (ResourceGovernor, BackpressureManager, IpcQueueManager) fighting over the same PTY's pause state causes desync. Use a reference-counted PtyPauseCoordinator.

title: fix(terminal): add IME composition guard to xterm key handler
summary: xterm custom onKey handlers must guard Enter with event.domEvent.isComposing. Without it, voice-to-text and IME input causes Enter to be swallowed or arrive before composed text.

title: fix(editor): suppress unhandled rejection in macOS open fallback
summary: execa detached child process missing .catch(). Post-return rejections escape the surrounding try/catch. In Electron 37+ utility processes, unhandled rejections are fatal. All detached execa calls need .catch(()=>{}).

title: feat(window): recover from renderer process crashes
summary: Electron render-process-gone recovery: 1st crash webContents.reload(); crash loop (3 in 60s) load static recovery.html with zero app-bundle deps (React may be broken). Wire unresponsive/responsive in prod only — HMR false positives in dev.

title: feat(disk-space): proactive disk space monitoring with user warnings
summary: DiskSpaceMonitor disk-pressure lesson: hysteresis (enter/exit thresholds + cooldown) prevents notification storms, and per-process writesSuppressed must be IPC-forwarded — not shared-memory — across the main/utility-process boundary. Corrected the #6271 attribution (that issue closed the main-process writer wiring; the cross-process forwarding gap is untracked) and fixed the stale "Canopy" brand name.

title: feat(crash-recovery): add crash loop protection with safe mode boot
summary: Electron crash-loop protection: disk-persisted counter + stability timer; safe mode skips state hydration; clean-shutdown sentinel prevents normal quits from incrementing counter; stop-relaunch threshold prevents auto-relaunch DoS.

title: feat(power): prevent system sleep during active agent work
summary: Power-management sleep blocker for active agent work has two leak traps: the OS blocker handle is an opaque integer easily lost (release-on-failure), and a single boolean "any agent working?" flag releases too early — reference-count concurrent agents instead so sleep stays blocked until the last finishes.

title: fix(fs): add atomic write utilities and migrate important file writes
summary: Atomic write pattern for Node/Electron: write .tmp, fsync, close, rename. fsync() is REQUIRED before rename on Linux—otherwise crash after rename but before cache flush loses data. Consolidate into shared util.

title: feat(persistence): SQLite backup, WAL checkpoint, and corruption recovery
summary: better-sqlite3 .backup() is the safe hot-backup API. WAL checkpoint must run before closeSharedDb(). Corruption recovery on startup: detect with PRAGMA quick_check, quarantine (rename to .corrupted-TIMESTAMP), restore from backup, else fresh init. Preserve corrupted files for forensics.

title: feat(lifecycle): add hard timeout to graceful shutdown cleanup chain
summary: Electron graceful-shutdown cleanup chain (flush buffers, close PTYs, save state, close DB) has no hard timeout, so a single hung step (non-exiting PTY, unresolved network call) freezes quit indefinitely; wrap the chain in a hard timeout so the process exits even when a phase stalls.

title: fix(terminal): prevent agent terminal flash on focus
summary: When reparenting xterm.js elements between DOM containers, set opacity:0 before appendChild and restore opacity:1 inside the rAF callback after terminal.refresh(). Add a safety timeout to restore visibility if rAF stalls. Reset opacity on early-return paths.

title: fix(main): move logger init after single-instance lock
summary: initializeLogger() called clearSessionLogs() before app.requestSingleInstanceLock(), so a second instance wiped the running instance's logs. Any initialization with side effects on shared resources must come after the single-instance lock check.

title: fix(scripts): strip ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE from spawned Electron environments
summary: ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 inherited from VS Code terminals causes Electron to run as plain Node.js, making require('electron') return an empty object. Every script spawning Electron must explicitly delete this env var before spawning.

title: fix(agent-state): increase working recovery debounce to prevent false transitions on layout shifts
summary: 300ms workingRecoveryDelayMs was within the duration of layout shift transients (worktree switches, panel resizes), causing false waiting→working agent state transitions. Increased to 1500ms — real LLM output is sustained for seconds, so longer debounce has no impact on legitimate transitions.

title: fix(build): force node-pty source rebuild — shipping prebuilds backfired
summary: PR #4224's switch to node-pty prebuilds (plus a beforeBuild hook and shipping prebuilds/) was reverted within a day: the beforeBuild hook made electron-builder skip asar unpacking and the prebuilds dir broke the macOS universal merge, so native modules are now force-rebuilt from source on every platform.

title: fix(pty): persist agent launch flags through crash recovery
summary: Crash recovery: agent launch flags (--dangerously-skip-permissions) must live in backend PTY state, not renderer state. Orphaned PTY rebuild reads TerminalPublicState; renderer-only flags are lost on crash/wipe.

title: fix(git): prevent 'external diff died' by removing broken diff.external= override
summary: Setting diff.external= (empty string) in git -c overrides does NOT disable external diff — git tries to execute the empty string as a program. Use --no-ext-diff flag on all git diff calls instead. Empty-string -c overrides for executable-valued git config keys are broken.

title: fix(review-hub): prevent commit textarea focus loss during re-renders
summary: React focus loss: textarea state inside polling-re-rendered parent loses focus mid-keystroke (git status poll unmounts subtree). Fix: lift state to parent as controlled prop, useRef in onChange to decouple from render, memoize input section.

title: feat(portal): LRU eviction for background WebContentsView tabs
summary: Portal tabs as WebContentsViews each spawn a Chromium process. LRU eviction keeps only 3 live views (active + 2 MRU). Eviction via webContents.close(); URL preserved for seamless recreation. Expose evicted tab IDs via IPC so renderer can show loading state on re-visit.

title: fix(editor): use platform-aware path methods for cross-platform test compatibility
summary: path.join() always uses host OS separator regardless of mocked process.platform. Tests mocking platform='darwin' on Windows get backslash paths and fail. Use path.posix.join() for macOS paths, path.win32.join() for Windows paths, selecting based on target platform.

title: feat(webview): lazy-load webviews for browser and dev-preview panels
summary: Lazy webview creation via IntersectionObserver + useHasBeenVisible (one-way first-visibility gate). Composable with useWebviewEviction—lazy creation and memory-pressure destruction are orthogonal. Saves Chromium processes for unvisited panels.

title: fix(pty): preserve user locale instead of hardcoding en_US.UTF-8
summary: fix(pty): preserve user locale instead of hardcoding en_US.UTF-8

title: fix(updater): add Linux guard for non-AppImage builds
summary: electron-updater on Linux throws 'APPIMAGE env is not defined' every check interval on .deb installs. Guard: skip initialize() if !process.env.APPIMAGE on Linux. Mirror of Windows PORTABLE_EXECUTABLE_FILE guard. Also applies to snap/Flatpak.

title: feat(terminal): derive hybrid input bar colors from xterm theme
summary: CodeMirror themes are build-time config, not CSS vars—xterm ITheme JS objects don't become CSS variables. Derive CM theme from ITheme via buildInputBarTheme(theme), store in Compartment, hot-swap via compartment.reconfigure() on scheme change.

title: feat(project-switcher): batch IPC calls to prevent memory overload freeze
summary: Project switcher: N individual project:get-stats IPC calls froze renderer (heap spike) for 10+ projects. Batch via single getBulkStats endpoint + 30s TTL renderer cache. Threshold ~5 items.

title: feat(terminal): suppress resize events during sidebar toggle
summary: feat(terminal): suppress resize events during sidebar toggle

title: fix(dev-preview): detect URL on first spawn without restart cycle
summary: DevPreviewTerminalController URL detection: early dev-server output can arrive before the data listener is wired (DevPreviewSessionService.ts remains the orchestrator owning handleData/UrlDetector), so a single-shot startup replay (setTimeout at STARTUP_REPLAY_DELAY_MS=1500ms re-feeding ptyClient.replayHistoryAsync, 300 lines) backstops the real-time UrlDetector listener.

title: fix(grid): restore layout correctly when exiting maximize mode
summary: Grid maximize restore dep cycle: effects depended on preMaximizeLayout they also cleared, interrupting restore. Use useRef mirror for read-without-react. Also use repeat(N, minmax(0,1fr)) + min-w-0 so grid children can shrink below content.

title: fix(portal): catch unhandled promise rejection in PortalManager.navigate()
summary: Electron 37+ crashes utility processes on unhandled promise rejections. webContents.loadURL() rejects on DNS/network/aborted navigation/redirect errors. Every loadURL() call needs .catch() handler.

title: fix(agent): no failed state — exit classification lives in terminalForensics, not the FSM
summary: The agent FSM (shared/utils/agentFsm.ts) has no `failed` state — error events are no-ops, every exit goes to `exited`, and crash-vs-routine exit classification was decoupled into terminalForensics.ts as a CRASH_SIGNALS blocklist (so exit 137=crash, exit 1=routine, reversing PR 4153's allowlist). Absorbs lesson 3195: no state is a true sink (input→working, respawn→idle escapes).

title: fix(worktree): scope group-hover with named groups to fix file text color
summary: Worktree card/file-list Tailwind hover scoping trap: unnamed `group`/`group-hover:` is shared across nested ancestors, so card hover fired file-row hover styles. Fixed stale group identifiers in the lesson (`group/file-row` -> `group/filerow`).

title: fix(grid): restore panel order after hydration
summary: Panel hydration creates new IDs; saved ordering array with old IDs falls back to default (lost layout). Remap via label matching: snapshot savedOrder pre-hydration, then restoreTerminalOrder(savedOrder, newPanels). Apply in app and project-switch rehydration.

title: fix(editor): add macOS .app bundle detection for external editors
summary: macOS: EditorService.findEditorBinary() missed .app bundles (users configure /Applications/IntelliJ IDEA.app, not CLI on PATH). Resolve via <bundle>/Contents/MacOS/<appname>. Add findInApplicationDirs() scanning /Applications + ~/Applications before PATH.

title: test(e2e): IPC listener and handler cleanup verification
summary: IPC listener/handler leak detection: expose ipcDiagnostics.getHandlerCount()/getListenerCount() through preload bridge. E2E pattern: baseline count → N open/close cycles → assert delta within threshold. Preload bridge is correct surface for main-process state.

title: feat(e2e): add nightly memory leak detection tests
summary: Memory leak thresholds: <20MB heap growth after 20 terminal cycles, <10MB external memory (node-pty native) after 10 cycles, error store bounded at 50 after 100 injections. Need process.memoryUsage() via main-process IPC (window.performance.memory is renderer-only).

title: test(e2e): add race condition tests for concurrent IPC operations
summary: UI debouncing serializes user operations and hides IPC race conditions. E2E: use page.evaluate() + Promise.all() to invoke IPC truly concurrently. Assert idempotency on same-ID spawns, queue overflow (51+) returns errors not hang, assert final state not ordering.

title: test(e2e): add error buffering flush E2E tests
summary: ErrorService (electron/ipc/errorHandlers.ts) buffers errors in a 50-entry pendingQueue when canSendToRenderer() is false and drains via flushPendingErrors() on renderer-ready; E2E coverage is timing-sensitive because the error must be injected after app start but before the renderer is ready, and a broken flush silently drops init-time errors.

title: fix(bulk-create): prevent double-execution and stale tracking ref
summary: BulkCreateWorktreeDialog: a parallel batchTrackingRef is invisible to the progress reducer's RESET, so it must be re-initialized at every RESET-dispatch site (open-transition useLayoutEffect + handleCreate) — not in close/done handlers — alongside an isExecutingRef guard against async double-invocation.

title: test(e2e): add terminal scrollback integrity under load test
summary: E2E coverage for xterm.js scrollback eviction under sustained high-volume output: verifies the buffer stays bounded at the per-type policy limit (PLAIN_POLICY 0.3x multiplier, capped 2000) without dropping or duplicating lines, and that the terminal remains interactive afterward rather than degrading.

title: refactor(portal): rename Sidecar to Portal across entire codebase
summary: Renaming a cross-layer Electron feature (Sidecar→Portal) is not a find-and-replace: the old name lives in a connected contract spanning action IDs, IPC channels, preload bridge namespaces, the Zustand store, and the session partition, so it can't land incrementally and the persisted partition name survives across launches.

title: E2E dnd-kit reorder: drive the keyboard sensor, not simulated mouse drags
summary: Panel-reorder E2E (e2e/full/panels/core-drag-drop.spec.ts) abandoned the flaky mouse-based dragElementTo helper for keyboardReorderElement, which drives dnd-kit's KeyboardSensor (wired in src/components/DragDrop/DndProvider.tsx) to hit the same handleDragEnd path deterministically instead of relying on headless Xvfb pointer geometry.

title: fix(terminal): pin agent terminal viewport via onWriteParsed + suppressed scrollToBottom
summary: xterm 6 terminal viewport pinning: onScroll carries no provenance, so the fix uses onWriteParsed-driven scrollToBottomSafe plus a _suppressScrollTracking try/finally guard (and DOM wheel/key signals for _userScrollIntent) to keep agent output pinned to the bottom without mislabeling programmatic scrolls as user intent. Corrects the lesson's prior claim of an _isWriting onScroll guard that never shipped.

title: feat(activity-monitor): add prompt lexeme fallback heuristic for generic prompt detection
summary: Pattern-based detection misses novel/unknown prompt formats. Added three-tier hierarchy: fast pattern match (500ms) -> stall+lexeme heuristic at 3s (output quiet + last line has ?, :, y/n, no trailing newline) -> idle timeout at 6s. Matches pexpect/SWE-agent canonical approach.

title: feat(pty): add universal approval prompt hint patterns for all agents
summary: All 5 agents share [y/N], Approve, Allow, Deny vocabulary for tool approval prompts but none were in detection patterns. Agents stayed in 'working' for 6s on every approval prompt. UNIVERSAL_PROMPT_HINT_PATTERNS fallback layer added covering shared vocabulary.

title: fix(detection): correct Cursor and OpenCode agent detection patterns
summary: Cursor completion verbs incomplete (3 of 8 matched), whitespace regex too strict; OpenCode braille spinner chars copied from Gemini—entirely wrong Unicode code points; interrupt hint text differed. All caused agents to stay stuck in 'working' until 6s idle timeout.

title: feat(agent-detection): keep Claude agent detection patterns matched to current CLI output
summary: Claude agent-state detection: spinner/verb/completion regexes drift from CLI output, but patterns now live in @generated sentinel blocks in shared/config/agents/claude.ts and are produced by the corpus-driven pipeline in scripts/pattern-discovery/ — re-validate via the corpus, not by hand-editing.

title: perf(terminal): simplify offscreen container CSS and use checkVisibility API
summary: Offscreen containers combined content-visibility:hidden + left:-20000px + pointer-events:none redundantly; -20000px forced wasted layout computation. ResizeController used rect.left < -10000 heuristic instead of checkVisibility() API.

title: feat(hibernation): protect active agents and git operations from hibernation
summary: Hibernation must scan for git sentinel files across ALL linked worktrees: index.lock, MERGE_HEAD, REBASE_HEAD, CHERRY_PICK_HEAD, rebase-merge/, rebase-apply/. Ignore stale locks older than inactivity threshold. Audit all hibernation entry points for ACTIVE_AGENT_STATES guard — scheduled and memory-pressure paths diverged.

title: feat(ui): improve DnD measurement stability and dock scroll robustness
summary: Three issues: (1) dnd-kit default bounding-box caching produces stale collision detection when CSS grid transitions run mid-drag — fix with MeasuringStrategy.Always + frequency:150; (2) missing overscroll-behavior-x:none on dock scroll container triggers macOS back-navigation gesture; (3) post-wake handlePostWake used stale cached dimensions from before a terminal's background-tier period instead of calling fit(), and only fired for alt-screen terminals. Per-terminal hibernation was later removed (PR #10811) — teaching now frames part 3 around the surviving reveal/reactivation path (handlePostWake in TerminalInstanceService.ts, driven by TerminalRevealController.ts/TerminalRendererPolicy.ts) rather than hibernation wake.

title: fix(pty-host): release SharedArrayBuffer references in cleanup
summary: PTY host cleanup() disposed managers but didn't nullify module-level SAB references (visualBuffers, visualSignalView, analysisBuffer). SABs are fixed non-movable V8 allocations — any lingering reference prevents GC. Existing null-guards made nullifying safe. Pattern: dispose then assign to empty/null, matching what ptyPool already did.

title: feat(ui): add global Escape key LIFO stack for layered UI dismissal
summary: Global Escape LIFO stack (src/lib/escapeStack.ts) for layered overlay dismissal — repointed to the current registerEscape/dispatchEscape API plus the document-bubble dialogEscapeBackstop and backstopAlreadyConsumedEscape() guard that prevents skipping a layer when a synchronous dialog close unregisters mid-event.

title: feat(terminal): add 'new output below' scroll indicator
summary: Overlays on xterm.js must use pointer-events:none on the container with pointer-events:auto only on the specific button. Standard overlay intercepts mouse events from xterm (selection, right-click, middle-click paste). Scroll state detection via xterm's onScroll + onData events, not DOM measurement. Use data-testid for E2E targeting.

title: Don't pace bulk worktree creation in the renderer — the backend leaky bucket owns cadence
summary: Bulk worktree creation: #3807's renderer-side PQueue interval throttle was superseded — the backend leaky-bucket rate limiter (electron/ipc/utils.ts, 1000ms strict interval) is now the sole cadence driver and `git worktree add --no-track` removed the .git/config.lock contention at the source.

title: feat(memory): reclaim renderer memory on window minimize and memory pressure
summary: Electron --disable-renderer-backgrounding (needed for terminal throughput) disables Chromium's Blink cache reclamation. webFrame.clearCache() (preload-only API) is the ONLY way to return Blink memory to OS; global.gc() frees V8 JS but V8 keeps heap pages so RSS stays flat. Wire via IPC with 5s minimize debounce.

title: V8 memory is tuned by heap LIMITS, not --optimize-for-size, and PTY-host GC is a no-op
summary: Daintree's three V8 tiers (main, renderer, PTY host) are tuned by heap-limit flags, not --optimize-for-size (added in #3793, reverted in 4b43022f7 with a test that now guards against re-adding it). The PTY host is forked without --expose-gc, so its global.gc() calls in stateConfig.ts/ResourceGovernor are guarded no-ops; --expose-gc lives only in the main process and renderers.

title: Route PTY output over direct MessagePort
summary: Asymmetric MessagePort smell: renderer→PTY used direct port for input but PTY→renderer output still relayed through main process (4-hop). High-throughput output CPU-bottlenecked main. When routing output directly, IPC onData must check messagePortConnected flag to avoid duplicate delivery.

title: Transparent envelope for IPC error serialization
summary: Electron structured clone strips ALL non-standard Error properties across IPC — thrown Error with code:'FILE_LOCKED' arrives as generic Error in renderer. Wrap IPC responses in {ok, data|error} envelope and unwrap in preload _unwrappingInvoke to preserve custom error fields across process boundary.

title: Persist trashed terminal PIDs for crash-safe cleanup
summary: macOS has ~511 system-wide PTY file descriptors; orphaned PTYs from crashes during 20s trash grace window exhaust them. setTimeout-only tracking loses state on crash. Persist pending-kill PIDs to disk + validate process command name before SIGKILL on startup (PID reuse safety).

title: Stabilize activity object reference for React.memo
summary: React.memo defeated when buildPanelProps constructs inline {headline,status,type} object literal — Object.is always fails on new refs. Per-terminal activityCache Map keyed by constituent values fixes it. Upstream store early-exit guards don't help if prop assembly runs on any field change.

title: refactor(security): remove bypassCSP from daintree-file protocol
summary: Electron protocol.registerSchemesAsPrivileged bypassCSP:true is nuclear — disables ALL CSP for scheme, not just images. Correct fix: add canopy-file: to img-src in both DEV_CSP and PROD_CSP strings in vite.config.ts. Keep secure/supportFetchAPI privileges.

title: revert(terminal): never wrap PTY writes in DEC 2026 — xterm batches natively; detect 2026 to gate reflow instead
summary: Terminal write path: wrapping raw PTY chunks in DEC Mode 2026 sequences corrupts output because chunk boundaries split ANSI escapes mid-sequence; xterm 6.0 batches natively, so detect synchronizedOutputMode to gate reflow instead of emitting 2026.

title: feat(terminal): dispose FileLinksAddon and ImageAddon for background-tier terminals
summary: xterm.js FileLinksAddon runs FILE_PATH_REGEX on every visible line during render — costly across 30-40 background agent terminals. Tier-manage dispose/recreate on BACKGROUND→VISIBLE transition. No public unloadAddon(); use addon.dispose() or IDisposable from registerLinkProvider().

title: feat(network): add fetch timeouts to GitHub API and Git operations
summary: simple-git constructor accepts timeout:{block:30_000}; Octokit/GraphQL needs explicit AbortController or AbortSignal.timeout(15_000). Without these, a slow GitHub API or git fetch hangs the whole feature indefinitely. Route timeout errors through parseGitHubError to serve stale cache instead of erroring.

title: fix(pty): kill orphaned PTY when TerminalProcess constructor throws
summary: node-pty PTY spawned in TerminalProcess constructor before fallible setup (agent config, headless terminal, handlers); throw leaves PTY orphaned because registry.add() runs AFTER constructor. Extract spawnPtyProcess() as standalone, try/catch, kill rawPty on failure. Separate acquisition from initialization.

title: feat(security): harden simple-git against malicious repo config RCE
summary: simple-git inherits malicious .git/config — core.fsmonitor runs arbitrary command on every git status/diff (CVE-2022-25912). Fix: createHardenedGit() passing -c core.fsmonitor=false, core.pager=cat, protocol.ext.allow=never + enforce path.isAbsolute(cwd) in validateCwd for renderer-supplied paths.

title: feat(pty): kill entire process tree on terminal close and app quit
summary: node-pty ptyProcess.kill() only SIGHUPs session leader; interactive shells setpgid() foreground commands (vite, next dev) into separate groups so even process.kill(-pid) misses them. Causes EADDRINUSE + macOS PTY exhaustion. Recursively pgrep -P, SIGTERM, escalate SIGKILL after 500ms. Windows: taskkill /T /F.

title: feat(csp): add form-action directive to webview CSP policy
summary: CSP form-action directive is NOT covered by default-src fallback and script-src doesn't restrict form submits — <form action=attacker.com> bypasses script-src entirely for HTML-injection exfiltration. Must list form-action explicitly in every webview CSP string.

title: perf(worktreeDataStore): preserve Map identity in mergeFetchedWorktrees
summary: Zustand Map stores: preserving individual entry refs isn't enough — returning new Map(...) container on every poll triggers all 12+ subscribers (default referential equality, no useShallow). Add size + per-entry identity check; return existingMap when all refs match to break the re-render cascade.

title: fix(activity-monitor): add disposed guard to prevent debounce timer leak
summary: Recursive setTimeout chains need a disposed flag check as FIRST line of callback — clearTimeout in dispose() only handles pre-fire timers, not callbacks already executing. Without it, PTY host crash leaves ActivityMonitor polling a dead terminal forever.

title: fix(security): restrict webview guest navigation to localhost URLs
summary: Electron webview guest navigation bypass: will-navigate on main window does NOT propagate to webview guest WebContents; must attach will-navigate in web-contents-created. setWindowOpenHandler only blocks window.open, not in-page nav.

title: feat(palette): replace manual debounce with useDeferredValue in all palettes
summary: React 19 useDeferredValue replaces manual setTimeout debounce in search palettes; adapts to render load automatically. Tests using jest.advanceTimersByTime must switch to act()/waitFor(). Centralize in shared hook.

title: feat(webview): validate webContentsId ownership in CDP handlers
summary: Electron CDP/debugger IPC handlers must validate webContentsId ownership via registry (e.g. WebviewDialogService.getPanelId) before attach; renderer can pass arbitrary IDs. Also: register-panel must fire BEFORE start-console-capture to avoid race.

title: fix(terminal): block OSC 52 clipboard hijacking from terminal output
summary: xterm.js 6.0 allowProposedApi:true enables OSC 52 clipboard writes - pastejacking vector via agent output. Block with terminal.parser.registerOscHandler(52, () => true) on every instance including prewarm. OSC 11 already overridden.

title: fix(hibernation): skip projects with falsy lastOpened instead of treating as epoch
summary: Never use `|| 0` fallback for timestamps in duration math — epoch 0 = 55 years ago = maximal staleness. Skip falsy timestamps instead. SQLite NOT NULL doesn't retroactively enforce on rows added pre-constraint via ALTER TABLE.

title: feat(terminal): use xterm.js onWriteParsed for adaptive output backpressure
summary: xterm.js 6.0 onWriteParsed event is the correct backpressure signal for output ingestion — fires once/frame when parser caught up. Replaces 8ms/25ms fixed flush timers. High/low watermarks 128KB/32KB for upstream pause/resume.

title: feat(pty-host): monitor PTY file descriptor usage to detect node-pty leaks
summary: feat(pty-host): monitor PTY file descriptor usage to detect node-pty leaks

title: Don't hand-add React.memo to palette items — the React Compiler (infer mode) memoizes them
summary: Palette/list rows (ActionPaletteItem, QuickSwitcherItem): manual React.memo wrappers are now superseded by babel-plugin-react-compiler running in infer mode, so hand-rolled memo is redundant noise unless a custom comparator or compiler bailout justifies it.

title: perf(selectors): optimize Zustand selectors to avoid unnecessary re-renders
summary: perf(selectors): optimize Zustand selectors to avoid unnecessary re-renders

title: feat(security): harden webview CSP and audit permission handlers
summary: Vite 6+ HMR no longer needs 'unsafe-eval' in CSP - remove it. Electron setPermissionRequestHandler/CheckHandler must have explicit default-deny for unknown permission types; otherwise new Electron versions add implicitly-allowed perms.

title: refactor(terminal): removing WebLinksAddon for backend OSC 8 broke clickable URLs (reverted)
summary: Terminal URL detection: deleting the frontend xterm WebLinksAddon in favor of backend UrlStyler OSC 8 broke pasted-URL and ANSI-colored agent-output links (different input populations, not equivalent); both the addon removal and the backend styler were reverted, and the addon is now the sole detector with a tier-based dispose/recreate lifecycle for the CPU concern.

title: feat(renderer): add global unhandled promise rejection handler
summary: Electron renderer needs explicit window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection'|'error') — unlike main/utility processes (Electron 37+ crashes on unhandled rejection), renderer silently swallows them. Filter AbortError, re-entry protect, cleanup on HMR.

title: refactor(store): eliminate active tab state duplication between focus and registry slices
summary: refactor(store): eliminate active tab state duplication between focus and registry slices

title: fix(activity-monitor): add maximum working silence timeout for hung agents
summary: ActivityMonitor guard checking subprocess liveness needs absolute max-duration from lastDataTimestamp (WORKING_SILENCE_TIMEOUT_MS=3min). Alive process can be stalled. Also: onProcessExit hook forces idle on PTY EOF immediately.

title: feat(gpu): add GPU crash fallback to disable hardware acceleration
summary: feat(gpu): add GPU crash fallback to disable hardware acceleration

title: feat(perf): always-on event loop lag and long task monitoring
summary: Event loop lag (main) and long-task/long-animation-frame (renderer PerformanceObserver) monitoring was gated behind the DAINTREE_PERF_CAPTURE=1 dev flag, so production jank was never observed or logged; removing the gate makes the monitors always-on. Trap: perf instrumentation that only runs in opt-in dev mode records nothing in real-world use.

title: fix(activity): stabilize agent state transitions to prevent working/waiting jitter
summary: fix(activity): stabilize agent state transitions to prevent working/waiting jitter

title: feat(skeleton): add startup skeleton UI shell to eliminate blank window
summary: Electron renders a blank white/black window between window show and the first React paint; cold starts and post-cache-invalidation V8 compilation widen the gap, making startup read as broken. Fix is a static skeleton HTML shell painted before React hydration to mask the void.

title: feat(watcher): replace timer-based git status with event-driven file watching
summary: Event-driven git status file-watching: working tree must be watched via @parcel/watcher (which silently drops overflow events, so the polling timer must stay), with adaptive debounce capped at WATCHER_WORKTREE_MAX_WAIT_MS=1500ms and failure recovery (git-only fallback + retry) owned by WatcherController, not gitFileWatcher.

title: fix(store): prevent input store state leaks across project switches
summary: resetAllStoresForProjectSwitch and per-terminal cleanup are separate flows - audit both when adding store. Mixing bare terminalId keys with composite projectId:terminalId in same store leaks history across projects; standardize on composite.

title: perf(renderer): enable V8 bytecode caching for faster startup
summary: perf(renderer): enable V8 bytecode caching for faster startup

title: fix(worktree): suppress WORKTREE_ACTIVATED echo for renderer-initiated activations
summary: Bidirectional IPC sync: unconditional echo-back from backend creates race where stale WORKTREE_ACTIVATED arrives after newer selection. Tag initiator (source:'renderer') and suppress echo to same side; renderer uses invoke return value instead.

title: fix(scheduler): replace requestIdleCallback with scheduler.postTask
summary: fix(scheduler): replace requestIdleCallback with scheduler.postTask

title: fix(drag): prevent iframe panels from stealing pointer events during drag
summary: fix(drag): prevent iframe panels from stealing pointer events during drag

title: fix(activity-monitor): add hysteresis to working/idle state transitions
summary: fix(activity-monitor): add hysteresis to working/idle state transitions

title: fix(terminal): two-phase directing state timeout for slow prompt composition
summary: fix(terminal): two-phase directing state timeout for slow prompt composition

title: fix(activity-monitor): prevent false idle during large non-polling output bursts
summary: fix(activity-monitor): prevent false idle during large non-polling output bursts

title: fix(terminal): immediately transition to working on Enter press
summary: fix(terminal): immediately transition to working on Enter press

title: fix(terminal): stop directing indicator firing on navigation and control keys
summary: fix(terminal): stop directing indicator firing on navigation and control keys

title: Remove backgroundThrottling: false and gate renderer timers on visibility
summary: Electron renderer power-saving: dropping backgroundThrottling:false plus gating every periodic hook (useGlobalMinuteTicker 30s singleton + useVisibilityAwareInterval per-second) on the Page Visibility API, and guarding xterm fit() against zero-size hidden-window layouts.

title: Migrate from Vite 6 to Vite 8 with Rolldown bundler
summary: Migrate from Vite 6 to Vite 8 with Rolldown bundler

title: Tune Vite build target for Electron Chromium version
summary: Tune Vite build target for Electron Chromium version

title: Replace private xterm.js API with structural type
summary: Replace private xterm.js API with structural type

title: Expand Windows Git PATH discovery for x86, Scoop, and Chocolatey
summary: Expand Windows Git PATH discovery for x86, Scoop, and Chocolatey

title: blockAltScreen survives per-agent; CI-env exclusion was deleted with terminal-identity unification
summary: PR #3417's two-part OpenCode TUI fix is now half-dissolved: the per-agent `blockAltScreen` capability (shared/config/agents/opencode.ts, consumed by TerminalParserHandler) still works, but the `AGENT_ENV_EXCLUSIONS`/`buildNonInteractiveEnv` CI-env exclusion it added was removed by commit 0506b3ccb when terminal identity unified to identical interactive shells.

title: Compute delta-based CPU% on Windows and fix activity fallback
summary: Compute delta-based CPU% on Windows and fix activity fallback

title: Discard orphaned dev-mode crash markers on startup
summary: Discard orphaned dev-mode crash markers on startup

title: Skip xterm WebGL renderer when Chromium reports software-only GPU
summary: Skip xterm WebGL renderer when Chromium reports software-only GPU

title: Chromium enforces 16 WebGL contexts per renderer — reserve headroom
summary: Chromium enforces 16 WebGL contexts per renderer — reserve headroom

title: Repository.pullRequests uses IssueOrder, not PullRequestOrder
summary: Repository.pullRequests uses IssueOrder, not PullRequestOrder

title: Circuit breaker backoff needs a cap and a success-driven auto-recovery
summary: Circuit breaker backoff needs a cap and a success-driven auto-recovery

title: Pre-check filesystem existence — circuit breakers can mask external deletions
summary: Pre-check filesystem existence — circuit breakers can mask external deletions

title: xterm 6.0 has no padding option — keep CSS gutter, sync its background to the active scheme
summary: XtermAdapter terminal gutter: xterm 6.0's ITerminalOptions has no `padding` field, so the gutter must stay CSS padding on the wrapper with its backgroundColor driven by an inline style from the terminalColorSchemeStore `selectWrapperBackground` selector — never a static Tailwind background class.

title: xterm onData fires for mouse/focus events — filter before treating as user input
summary: xterm onData fires for mouse/focus events — filter before treating as user input

title: Coordinate cross-store cleanup through onTerminalRemoved, not component unmount
summary: Coordinate cross-store entity cleanup from the owning store's onRemoved hook, not React component unmount — programmatic removal bypasses unmount.

title: Make WorktreeLifecycleService cross-platform (process groups, detached, PATH)
summary: Make WorktreeLifecycleService cross-platform (process groups, detached, PATH)

title: Use taskkill /T to kill orphaned PTY process trees on Windows
summary: Use taskkill /T to kill orphaned PTY process trees on Windows

title: Use native title bar on Linux (frameless breaks GNOME/KDE)
summary: Use native title bar on Linux (frameless breaks GNOME/KDE)

title: Don't LRU-pool xterm WebGL contexts inside the renderer — flip the whole fleet between WebGL and DOM by count
summary: TerminalWebGLManager no longer LRU-pools WebGL contexts; an in-renderer LRU evictor fought Chromium's own context cap and strobed at 12-20 terminals, so it was replaced (commit 7b0d1e312) by a count-based webgl/dom mode switch with rAF-staggered attach/release; thresholds are now RAM-tiered (bootstrap 18/15, #11192) against a raised >=24-context ceiling instead of the old flat 12/10 against Chromium's default 16.

title: Debounce terminal-title state changes — spinner frames cause rapid flapping
summary: Debounce terminal-title state changes — spinner frames cause rapid flapping

title: Filter ANSI CR-overwrite cosmetic redraws from terminal activity tracking
summary: Filter ANSI CR-overwrite cosmetic redraws from terminal activity tracking

title: Detect alternate screen buffer when restoring PTY sessions — don't replay vim/htop state
summary: Detect alternate screen buffer when restoring PTY sessions — don't replay vim/htop state

title: Flush PTY session snapshot BEFORE kill — debounced writes are cancelled
summary: PTY session-snapshot persistence: a debounced scrollback write is cancelled by kill() and re-blocked by the wasKilled guard, so the flush must run synchronously inside kill() before teardown (flushSyncOnKill), with a guarded dispose-time variant (flushSyncOnDispose) for the timer-never-fired path.

title: Persist agent launch flags so session resume matches the original launch
summary: Persist agent launch flags so session resume matches the original launch

title: xterm terminal.reset() destroys scroll position — capture and restore across session-restore
summary: xterm terminal.reset() destroys scroll position. Capture scrollBackOffset before reset, reapply via scrollToLine after write, gate on isUserScrolledBack.

title: Use null-byte delimiter in git log --format to handle pipe chars in commit bodies
summary: Git log --format pipe delimiter corrupted by | in commit bodies. Use null-byte (\0) delimiter in git log, guard isNaN dates downstream.

title: WorktreeRemovedError detection must cover 'not a git repository' from git worktree remove
summary: WorktreeRemovedError only caught ENOENT. git worktree remove produces 'not a git repository' with directory still present — enumerate all tool-error shapes for resource-gone, call onRemoved+stop not just error state.

title: CSP needs frame-src blob: and img-src https: for Gutenberg-style editors in webview
summary: CSP needs frame-src blob: and img-src https: for Gutenberg/rich editors in webview. Test CSP per-directive not against full concatenated string.

title: autoUpdater.quitAndInstall bypasses before-quit cleanup on macOS — call cleanup explicitly
summary: macOS autoUpdater.quitAndInstall closes windows before before-quit fires, skipping cleanup that needs mainWindow. Call cleanup explicitly before quitAndInstall in try/catch.

title: Focus trap must check closest aria-modal ancestor to avoid disrupting portaled popovers
summary: AppDialog focus trap broke nested Radix popovers (portaled outside dialog DOM). Check closest aria-modal ancestor before intercepting Tab; auto-focus via requestAnimationFrame with tabIndex=-1 fallback.

title: Buffer errors sent before the renderer is ready — never drop on a missing window
summary: sendError dropped when mainWindow destroyed or not did-finish-load. Buffer in memory (capped) + persist critical errors to electron-store, flush on did-finish-load, expose pull IPC for renderer drain.

title: requestAnimationFrame deferral on input submit creates a blur-race that drops user input
summary: HybridInputBar editor submit: deferring Enter-to-send via requestAnimationFrame opened a ~16ms blur-race that silently dropped paste-and-submit input; synchronous send is the fix, with setTimeout(0) only for CodeMirror compositionend.

title: electron-store v11 throws on store.set(key, undefined) — use store.delete() or write an explicit default
summary: Main-process persistence trap: electron-store v11 throws on store.set(key, undefined); clear via store.delete() or an explicit default. Repointed away from the now-Drizzle ProjectStore to live electron-store call sites (logs.ts handleClearLevelOverrides, migration 013) and the test-mock assertion.

title: preventDefault in before-input-event stops the key reaching the renderer — use setIgnoreMenuShortcuts
summary: event.preventDefault() in Electron before-input-event swallows the keydown from the renderer; use webContents.setIgnoreMenuShortcuts(true) to block native accelerators only

title: Duplicate CSS variable declarations in @theme inline let the later one win silently
summary: Tailwind v4 @theme inline does not deduplicate; duplicate --color-* declarations silently let the later one win, causing invisible theme/contrast bugs — grep before adding

title: Inline array in useEffect deps fires cleanup on every parent render
summary: Inline arrays from parent props are new references each render; a useEffect with them in deps runs cleanup every render — mount/unmount-only effects MUST have empty deps

title: Electron native Menu sublabel renders shortcuts on a second line — use Radix for inline hints
summary: Electron native Menu sublabel always renders on a second line; no API to show shortcuts inline — use Radix DOM context menus for modern inline-shortcut menus

title: Measuring .cm-line with getBoundingClientRect is inflated by chip/widget decorations
summary: Measuring .cm-line via getBoundingClientRect returns inflated height when a decoration/widget is present; use view.defaultLineHeight and guard style writes

title: backdrop-blur on an ancestor creates a containing block for position:fixed descendants
summary: backdrop-filter/blur/transform/filter on any ancestor creates a new containing block for position:fixed children; modals must be portaled to document.body

title: Register IPC handlers before loading the renderer to avoid startup race
summary: Register all IPC handlers synchronously before loadURL; use late-bound HandlerDependencies object for async-init services and make re-invocations idempotent

title: Dev preview URL detection broken by OSC 8 hyperlinks and C1 controls
summary: Dev preview URL detection must handle OSC 8 ST terminator, 8-bit C1 OSC (0x9D), and exclude 0x80-0x9f from URL character classes when stripping ANSI.

title: Windows COMSPEC is always cmd.exe — PowerShell fallback never reached
summary: Windows COMSPEC always equals cmd.exe, so env.COMSPEC||powershell fallback is dead code. Probe pwsh.exe then powershell.exe via where with timeout.

title: Linux clipboard file URIs and inotify ENOSPC handling
summary: Clipboard text/uri-list + git directory watching: RFC 2483 CRLF file:// URIs (copyTree.ts) and dual-limit/dual-phase inotify ENOSPC + macOS FSEvents EMFILE handling now centralized in GitFileWatcher.handleWorktreeWatcherError, with the recursive watch moved to @parcel/watcher and fs.watch kept for individual git files.

title: Ubuntu 24.04 AppArmor userns blocks Electron; Wayland needs Ozone flags
summary: Ubuntu 24.04 restricts unprivileged userns crashing Electron sandbox. Ship AppArmor profile via .deb postinst, and set Ozone platform hints before whenReady() for Wayland.

title: Windows path detection and HOME env variable pitfalls
summary: On Windows use path.isAbsolute() not startsWith('/'), use os.homedir() not env.HOME, and prepend Git-for-Windows install dirs to PATH since they are not in system PATH by default.

title: Universal macOS build fails on node-pty with lipo error
summary: electron-rebuild produces already-universal Mach-O for node-pty on Apple Silicon. Declare these binaries in build.mac.x64ArchFiles so lipo does not try to merge two fat files.

title: Wrapping ipcMain.on listeners must preserve removeListener identity
summary: Wrapping ipcMain.on listeners for security validation must track wrapped refs in a map so removeListener/off/removeAllListeners still work - EventEmitter uses reference equality.

title: Detect branch changes by reading gitDir/HEAD directly
summary: For instant branch-change UI updates, read gitDir/HEAD directly on watcher fire rather than polling git. Linked worktrees require watching gitDir/logs/HEAD not just commonDir.

title: Production source maps expose TypeScript source in distributed ASAR
summary: Production builds leak TypeScript source via sourcemaps - need Vite sourcemap:false, NODE_ENV=production on build:main script for esbuild gate, and clean dist-electron between builds.

title: Terminal resize SIGWINCH reflow spoofs ActivityMonitor into busy state
summary: SIGWINCH triggers TUI reflow bursts that ActivityMonitor misreads as agent activity. Suppress idle->busy transitions for ~1s after resize across all detection paths.

title: Ratatui TUIs (Codex) corrupt on rapid PTY/xterm resize races
summary: Ratatui TUIs (Codex/Gemini) corrupt on rapid resize. Skip post-wake bounce, atomize PTY+xterm resize in same frame, inject clear via xterm not PTY stdin, clear settled timers on detach.

title: Hardcoded line-height constants break at fractional browser zoom
summary: Hardcoded LINE_HEIGHT_PX breaks at fractional browser zoom. Measure lineHeight from DOM, use 2px epsilon tolerance, short-circuit empty documents, prefer Math.round over Math.ceil.

title: Dev servers print URL before accepting HTTP connections
summary: Dev Preview readiness: dev servers (Vite/Next/Webpack) print their URL before the HTTP listener accepts connections, so poll before wiring the webview. Repointed to the extracted DevPreviewReadinessProbe.ts (waitForServerReady) and corrected the probe to GET-with-2xx/3xx-ready (4xx is fail, not ready), multi-host localhost fallback, HMR WebSocket confirmation, and the dual generation + signal-identity guard.

title: Main worktree IS git's first porcelain entry — don't path-match it
summary: WorktreeListService main-worktree detection: PR #2251 swapped first-entry positional detection for canonical-path comparison against projectRootPath, which failed closed (no entry flagged main when realpath/case/null comparison missed) and broke delete protection (#3946); commit 405db4eae reverted to isMainWorktree: isFirstEntry, since git's porcelain output guarantees main is first.

title: In-flight fetch promises can resurrect invalidated cache entries
summary: Cache-with-in-flight-promise patterns need ownership tokens — completing promises can write stale results back after invalidation and resurrect deleted entries

title: Webview dom-ready does not re-fire on already-ready webviews after remount
summary: Electron webview dom-ready does not re-fire on remount of an already-ready webview — probe getURL()/isLoading() on mount and add timeout recovery

title: xterm.js initialized with 0x0 dimensions when conditionally mounted
summary: xterm.js initialized inside conditionally-mounted container sees 0x0 dimensions — mount unconditionally and hide with CSS, never with {open && <Xterm/>}

title: Agent working-state missed because input bar splits body and Enter into separate writes
summary: HybridInputBar splits body+Enter into separate async writes — ActivityMonitor needs direct notifySubmission() calls at enqueue and dequeue, not byte-pattern heuristics

title: Pooled PTYs start in home dir, not the worktree — bypass the pool for cwd-sensitive spawns
summary: PtyPool warms terminals in home directory, so dev-preview/cwd-sensitive spawns must bypass the pool and be guarded with runtime assertions

title: Git status cache TTL must be shorter than worktree poll interval
summary: Git status cache TTL must be strictly shorter than worktree poll interval — otherwise cache absorbs refreshes and UI shows stale data for multiple cycles

title: ResizeObserver does not fire in overlay mode — explicit state deps needed for xterm fit
summary: ResizeObserver does not fire for overlay-mode sidecars (container unchanged) — xterm fit effects must explicitly depend on overlay state, not just container size

title: Race condition: terminal agents spawning before worktree directory exists
summary: git worktree add returning success does not guarantee fs.access sees the directory; use waitForPathExists with exponential backoff before spawning PTY into a freshly created cwd.

title: Preserve browser/webview panel state in dock across show/hide cycles
summary: Electron <webview> loses state on unmount; use a stable offscreen React portal target to keep dock panels alive while hidden rather than conditional rendering.

title: Activity tier desync between PTY host and renderer after project switch
summary: PTY-host and renderer tier state desynced on reconnect because snapshot had no activityTier; reconnect/hydration IPC must carry every state field the renderer would otherwise re-initialize.

title: Cmd+Alt+letter keybindings broken on macOS because Alt transforms the character
summary: macOS Option transforms letters to special chars (Alt+P -> π); derive key identity from event.code not event.key for Alt chords on mac, gated to darwin to preserve AltGr on Linux.

title: Terminal resize clearing alt screen because of dual alt-buffer tracking with mismatched property
summary: Dual alt-buffer tracking (parser DECSET vs xterm onBufferChange) drifts silently; trust xterm.js first-party state as single source of truth, delete parallel trackers outright.

title: Zod schema for persisted panels dropped non-PTY panels by requiring PTY-only fields
summary: Persisted panel Zod schema dropped non-PTY panels by requiring type/cwd; use per-kind refinement, kind-inference fallback for legacy states, and single-pass hydration preserving order.

title: Waiting on utility-process ready without reject handlers hangs app startup
summary: PTY-host utility-process startup: a readyPromise with only a happy-path resolver (no fork try/catch, exit-before-ready reject, or late-ready guard) hangs app startup forever. Repointed stale paths to electron/services/pty/PtyHostLifecycle.ts (mechanism), windowServices.ts (call-site), and bootstrapErrorGuard.ts.

title: Concurrent request-response IPC needs unique request IDs, not per-terminal callbacks
summary: Request-response IPC must key pending callbacks by a unique requestId, not by the resource ID; concurrent callers otherwise overwrite each other's callbacks and cause hangs.

title: JSON.stringify throws TypeError on BigInt — crashes any log/diag viewer
summary: JSON.stringify throws TypeError on BigInt with no spec-level representation; safeStringify must handle BigInt, circular refs, Errors, and a top-level try/catch fallback.

title: Regex-based GitHub URL parsing truncates repos with dots in the name
summary: Regex-based GitHub URL parsing truncates repos with dots in the name (.github, my.repo); use new URL() and strip .git/trailing slash explicitly, with SSH form as its own branch.

title: redactSensitiveData stack-overflowed on circular objects and mishandled null
summary: Recursive object walkers need both WeakSet cycle detection and explicit !== null guards because typeof null === 'object'; applies to redactors, serializers, and deep-clone helpers.

title: Word-boundary regex does not match underscores — breaks secret detection
summary: Word-boundary regex \b does not match across underscores in ECMAScript, so /\btoken\b/ fails on GITHUB_TOKEN; use substring matching for secret-key detection.

title: IPC fallback path needs backpressure or agent output OOMs the main process
summary: Every PTY output transport needs bounded queuing with node-pty pause/resume at 90%/50% thresholds; IPC fallback path had no flow control and OOMed main on chatty agents.

title: Agent activity regex patterns need the 'm' flag for $ to match line ends
summary: JS regex $ only anchors end-of-string without the 'm' flag. Multi-line scan buffers require `new RegExp(pattern, 'im')`. Canopy centralizes this in compilePatterns — go through it.

title: Use a monotonic checkId to guard async refresh against stale results
summary: For async refresh with shared cache, issue a monotonic checkId at request start and only commit results if the id still matches — simpler than AbortController when the work can't truly be cancelled.

title: GraphQL variable named $query is rejected by @octokit/graphql
summary: @octokit/graphql reserves 'query' as the request-body key, so naming a GraphQL variable $query always fails. Rename to $searchQuery or similar in both operation and variables object.

title: Never fall back to process.cwd() for userData paths
summary: Never fall back to process.cwd() for userData paths; build platform-specific defaults from os.homedir() and validate env overrides as absolute. Otherwise cache files end up in user project roots.

title: Terminal echo during typing looks like agent activity without a corroborating second signal
summary: ActivityMonitor agent-state detection: output-only busy detection false-positives on PTY keystroke echo; echo is now suppressed by InputTracker.isLikelyUserEcho/isRecentUserInput while CpuHighStateTracker only gates idle-exit hysteresis (not busy-entry), so output-based transitions need a corroborating second signal.

title: Non-bracketed-paste agents need output-settle, not fixed delay, before Enter
summary: For non-bracketed-paste agents (Gemini) use output-settle debounce anchored to submit start, not a fixed delay, before sending Enter — fixed sleeps drop characters under load or on large pastes.

title: MessagePort postMessage silently fails on non-serializable fields in nested state
summary: MessagePort.postMessage silently drops payloads that contain class instances / timers / functions; deep-clone snapshots centrally before sending across process boundaries.

title: CSP frame-ancestors in a meta tag is ignored and logs a warning
summary: CSP frame-ancestors (and sandbox, report-uri, report-to) are ignored in meta tags; only HTTP headers enforce them. Drop them from vite.config PROD_CSP to avoid console warnings.

title: Electron menu `role: reload` ships with a built-in Cmd+R accelerator you cannot suppress
summary: Electron menu role:'reload' bundles a built-in Cmd+R accelerator that cannot be overridden; drop the role and write an explicit click handler to have the menu item without the shortcut.

title: PTY backend crash recovery: close stale MessagePort, soft-reset xterm, reattach listeners immediately
summary: PTY backend crash recovery: attach listeners synchronously in constructor, close old MessagePort before replacing, soft-reset via DECSTR before xterm resetRenderer to avoid white-text glitch.

title: Per-terminal renderer-ACK PAUSE deadlocked terminals that never mount xterm
summary: PTY flow control: the legacy per-terminal renderer-ACK PAUSE deadlocked background terminals that never mounted xterm; cured by making TerminalProcess.acknowledgeData a no-op, with live throttling now done by the MessagePort/IPC queue ACK/watermark system (SAB transport never shipped).

title: Electron safeStorage is main-process only — utility processes need memory-only token propagation
summary: Electron safeStorage is main-process only; utility processes need memory-only token propagation pushed via IPC on the 'ready' event (not 'spawn'), re-sent on every restart.

title: Activity/input detectors must honor bracketed paste or they treat paste newlines as Enter
summary: Input/activity detectors must track bracketed-paste markers (\x1b[200~/201~) and ignore newlines inside, buffer split escapes across chunks, and timeout-exit stuck paste state.

title: Branch names with slashes break filenames: sanitize before using as path component
summary: Branch names legally contain slashes/at/hash/dot but filenames can't. Sanitize to [a-zA-Z0-9_-], collapse dashes, cap at 100 chars, fallback to 'head' when empty.

title: System sleep/wake: debounced powerMonitor plus PTY output circuit breaker
summary: Sleep/wake needs debounced powerMonitor handlers (collapse rapid cycles) plus PTY output circuit breaker with cooldown. Otherwise health checks misfire and IPC floods on wake.

title: TSC dual-compilation race: two tsconfigs emitting the same shared directory
summary: Two tsconfigs emitting the same shared/ directory race and corrupt output. Fix with composite TypeScript project references and tsc -b; never overlap emit paths.

title: Environment-aware CSP via Vite plugin: strip localhost from production builds
summary: Vite build/CSP: a single static CSP meta tag in index.html shipped dev-only localhost allowances into production; fix is environment-aware swap via a transformIndexHtml plugin (csp-transform), with bodies sourced from shared/config/csp.ts so the build-time meta tag and main-process HTTP header stay aligned.

title: Windows worktree paths broken by forward-slash string splitting in renderer
summary: Renderer must never do filesystem path arithmetic; split('/') broke Windows worktree path suggestions. Move path.basename/dirname/join to main process via IPC.
